question: Whether available case RNA/proteomics supports SMAD4-independent TGF-beta signalling, particularly ERK, and strengthens vactosertib rationale.

primary_sources.title: A transcriptional MAPK Pathway Activity Score (MPAS) is a clinically relevant biomarker in multiple cancer types
primary_sources.interpretation: Published MAPK-responsive footprint, not TGF-beta-specific. Original score sums gene-level z-scores divided by sqrt(10); new within-sample rank summaries must be labelled as rescoring, not clinically calibrated MPAS.

primary_sources.title: TGF-beta activates Erk MAP kinase signalling through direct phosphorylation of ShcA
primary_sources.interpretation: Primary demonstration of receptor-ShcA-Grb2-Sos-ERK route independent of the canonical SMAD complex. Shared downstream components and outputs with receptor tyrosine kinases prevent causal ligand attribution from baseline abundance.

primary_sources.title: Antimetastatic role of Smad4 signaling in colorectal cancer
primary_sources.interpretation: TGF-beta-induced ERK activation and LY2109761 efficacy in SMAD4-deficient CRC. Other measured pathways including Akt were unaffected in this study. Not vactosertib, not G359E.

primary_sources.title: TGFbeta drives immune evasion in genetically reconstituted colon cancer metastasis
primary_sources.interpretation: Includes separate CRISPR Smad4-loss LAKP+S arm besides main Tgfbr2-deficient model. Galunisertib suppresses metastatic capacity; compartment/context evidence, no human mutation-specific vactosertib selector.

primary_sources.title: Smad4 dependency defines two classes of TGF-beta target genes
primary_sources.interpretation: SMAD4-independent transcription need not mean non-SMAD signalling: SMAD2/3-mediated responses can persist without SMAD4. Dependence is cell-context-specific; cannot treat a list of target genes as a universal allele-function assay.

primary_sources.title: The type I TGF-beta receptor engages TRAF6 to activate TAK1 in a receptor kinase-independent manner
primary_sources.interpretation: Primary demonstration in a specific experimental context that TGFBR1–TRAF6–TAK1 signalling can bypass receptor kinase activity. Do not assume all noncanonical TGF-beta signalling is inhibited by an ALK5 kinase inhibitor.

inference_hierarchy: Protein/RNA abundance shows components available; not kinase activity.
ERK-responsive transcription can support output but is temporally variable and compositional.
Activation-loop phospho-ERK (ERK1 Thr202/Tyr204; ERK2 Thr185/Tyr187) more directly reports kinase activation; must verify measured sites and assay.
Even phospho-ERK does not establish TGF-beta as the upstream driver.
Vactosertib sensitivity needs dependence/clinical predictive evidence, not merely pathway coexistence.
data_limits: Treat each unique biological specimen separately; Tempus and BostonGene share B4.
Only validated specimen assignment can count Valius data as liver.
Blood cfRNA/buffy coat are not tumour replications.
No organoid/culture proposal: user reports insufficient cryopreserved tissue.
External CRC references are research context, not assay-matched clinical percentiles.
Historical RNA, total protein and bulk signatures cannot establish current nodal cancer-cell pathway state.
